evidence_quotes: Change in Valmet Oyj’s holding of treasury shares
On September 18, 2026, a total of 1,705 Valmet shares have been returned free of consideration to Valmet Oyj according to the terms and conditions of the Deferred Share Plan 2024–2026.
data.date_evidence: Valmet Oyj’s stock exchange release on September 18, 2026 at 11:30 a.m. EEST
data.reason: The item reports on the treasury shares of the Finnish parent entity Valmet Oyj, not the Norwegian target company Valmet AS.
